result.summary: The image depicts a residential urban intersection featuring brick row houses and a marked ladder-style crosswalk. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, visibility is compromised by vehicles parked close to the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the curb right up to the crosswalk limit sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signal
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads to indicate safe crossing intervals.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal pole on the left corner.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear guidance on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image depicts a standard urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and continuous sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps and street lighting is present, the environment lacks advanced safety features such as curb extensions or pedestrian refuge islands to shorten crossing distances.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the left side may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway near the crosswalk entrance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a standard urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The environment features sidewalks on both sides and mixed-use buildings, though visibility is somewhat hindered by parked vehicles near the crossing and significant sun glare.

hazards.name: Sun Glare
hazards.description: Intense direct sunlight may reduce driver visibility of pedestrians entering or within the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners (lack of daylighting) can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street approaching the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: This residential street features continuous sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the lack of visible traffic control devices and the presence of parked cars right up to the crossing point create visibility and right-of-way hazards.

hazards.name: Poor Daylighting
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on both sides of the street extend to the edge of the crosswalk, obstructing sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides adjacent to the foreground crosswalk

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: There are no visible stop signs or traffic signals to regulate vehicle movement at this marked crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection corners to prevent parking too close to the crosswalk, improving visibility and shortening the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table, physically slowing traffic and increasing pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Add high-visibility 'Pedestrian Crossing' signs (W11-2) to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.
